recentItems.title: President Ramaphosa addresses SAPS Commemoration Day
recentItems.description:
President Cyril Ramaphosa delivers the keynote address at the annual South African Police Service (SAPS) Commemoration Day at the Union Buildings in Pretoria. 

Ramaphosa commiserated with the families and colleagues of police officers who lost their lives in the line of duty over a 12-month period between April 1, 2025, and March 31, 2026.

recentItems.title: SAPS National Commemoration Day
recentItems.description:
President of the Republic of South Africa, Mr Cyril Ramaphosa, joined families of police officers who lost their lives in the line of duty at the annual South African Police Service (SAPS) Commemoration Day. Ramaphosa laid a wreath at the foot of the SAPS Memorial Wall in honour of the fallen members. Acting Minister of Police, Professor Firoz Cachalia, and Acting National Commissioner of the SAPS, Lieutenant General P. P. Dimpane, also participated in the wreath-laying ceremony as a formal expression of respect and remembrance for the officers who made the ultimate sacrifice in service to the nation.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Future of Work | AI and automation are reshaping South Africa’s employment landscape
recentItems.description:
Technology is rapidly changing the way businesses operate, with digitisation, automation, and artificial intelligence reshaping the workplace.

As companies turn to technology to improve productivity, some traditional roles could disappear or require fewer workers. 

This is raising important questions about South Africa's job market and whether workers are prepared for the changing world of work.

For more on how technology is reshaping jobs, skills and employment opportunities, we speak to Masande Dyasi, Managing Director at Sourcewox.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: President Ramaphosa to lead national memorial service in honour of slain police officers
recentItems.description:
President Cyril Ramaphosa will this morning join the families and colleagues of police officers who lost their lives in the line of duty at the annual South African Police Service Commemoration Day. 

The event will take place at the SAPS Memorial Site at the Union Buildings in Pretoria, where the nation will honour and remember members of the SAPS who made the ultimate sacrifice in service to the people of South Africa. 

For more on this we are now joined by SABC News anchor Heidi Giokos. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: SA Weather | Johannesburg Emergency Services on high alert as risk warnings remain
recentItems.description:
It's a potentially disruptive day, with severe thunderstorms bringing heavy rain, flooding, damaging winds, hail, and lightning in parts of the country.

Conditions should improve from Monday or Tuesday,  but the South African Weather Service (SAWS) says some risks remain.

For more, we're joined by meteorologist Lehlohonolo Thobela and Johannesburg EMS spokesperson Robert Mulaudzi.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: UDM set to launch manifesto, announce City of Joburg mayoral candidate today
recentItems.description:
The United Democratic Movement (UDM) is set to launch its City of Johannesburg manifesto today, outlining its vision and priorities for the metro ahead of the upcoming local government elections.

The party will also announce its mayoral candidates as it steps up its campaign to contest control of Johannesburg.

recentItems.title: Theatre | Semi-Soet – The Musical heads to Joburg at The Teatro
recentItems.description:
Semi-Soet – The Musical heads to Joburg at The Teatro, Montecasino, from 4 to 27 September 2026. 

Based on the popular romantic film of the same name, the Afrikaans musical brings together romance, humour, music and energy, with Bobby van Jaarsveld and Anel Alexander returning as JP and Jaci. 

To share more on the production, we're joined by cast members Thiart Li and Zoricke Snyman.

recentItems.title: Madlanga Commission recess: What happens next?
recentItems.description:
The Madlanga Commission has adjourned for a temporary recess, and is scheduled to resume hearings on September 15 2026.

Evidence before the Madlanga Commission suggested that the Hawks' presence at the December 6, 2024, takedown operation of alleged cartel member Katiso "KT" Molefe was not for a verification check, but rather for interference. 

UKZN criminologist Professor Nirmala Devi Gopal joins us to unpack behind-the-scenes operations, the gathering of evidence, and more.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
